warning.warningAndCautionPara: ALL THE CLEANING MATERIAL USED MUST BE VALIDATED BY SAFRAN SEATS FRANCE. IF THE CLEANING MATERIAL IS NOT VALIDATED BY SAFRAN SEATS FRANCE, THE PARTS WILL DECREASE THE GUARANTEE.
OBEY THE MANUFACTURERS' INSTRUCTIONS WHEN USING PROPRIETARY CLEANERS.

USE CLEANING AGENTS ONLY IN AN AREA WITH A GOOD SUPPLY OF AIR. OBEY LOCAL SAFETY AND HEALTH INSTRUCTIONS. OBEY THE MANUFACTURERS INSTRUCTIONS. WEAR PROTECTION CLOTHING. DO NOT DRINK SOLVENTS/CLEANING AGENTS. DO NOT SMOKE. DO NOT BREATHE THE FUMES. SOLVENT/CLEANING AGENTS ARE POISONOUS AND FLAMMABLE. USE THE APPROVED HAND AND EYE PROTECTION WHEN YOU APPLY THE CLEANING AGENT. IF YOU GET THE CLEANING AGENT ON YOUR SKIN OR IN YOUR EYES, FLUSH IT AWAY WITH CLEAN WATER AND GET MEDICAL AID.

caution.warningAndCautionPara: DO NOT STEAM CLEAN THE ASSEMBLY. DO NOT LET LIQUIDS FLOW INTO AREAS WHERE IT WILL NOT DRY.
TO PREVENT DAMAGE TO SURFACES DO NOT USE SOLVENTS.
NEWLY PAINTED SURFACES MUST NOT BE CLEANED FOR FOURTEEN (14) DAYS.
DO NOT ALLOW CLEANER TO DRY ON PAINTED SURFACES.
USE ONLY SPECIFIED MATERIALS OR THEIR EQUIVALENT. MATERIALS THAT ARE NOT SPECIFIED CAN DAMAGE THE SURFACE PROTECTION.
DO ALL THE WORK WITH A FULLY CLEAN WORKBENCH, TOOLS AND PART.
ALL THE CONSUMABLES SUPPLIED BY SAFRAN AND LISTED INTO THE CMP CAN HAVE A LIMITED LIFETIME. PLEASE REVIEW LABELS ON CONTAINER OR EXAMINE THE TECHNICAL DATA SHEET BEFORE USE OR STORE.
